ABOUT

Women's health, cared for
with understanding.

Nivedhaa K.G., M.P.T. (Women’s Health) is a Women’s Health Physiotherapist passionate about supporting women through every stage of life — from menarche to motherhood and beyond.

With experience in clinical practice, teaching, and research, she believes physiotherapy should be evidence-based, personalised, and empowering. Through Bump & Beyond Physiotherapy, Nivedhaa strives to help women understand their bodies, move with confidence, recover better, and feel supported throughout their journey.
